power.devkit_isolation: No series diode between F1 and +5V. A Schottky would drop about 0.4-0.5 V at 1-1.5 A and push the Catalex microSD module (4.5-5.5 V) out of range. Factory rule: never connect the DevKitC USB and the rear USB-C at the same time; flash through the rear USB-C. Fit a low-drop ideal-diode stage in a later revision if the factory needs both ports at once.
